name: Xivilai Toxicoli

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Uppercut
abilities.description: A melee attack that deals moderate physical damage and knocks you back if it connects. This attack can be blocked to knock the enemy off balance.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: The Ravager swings their weapon around, dealing minor physical damage to all enemies in front of them. This attack has no red cone indicator.

abilities.name: Poison Throw
abilities.description: The xivilai forms a ball of poison in his hands then flings it at you, dealing moderate poison damage followed by poison damage over time.

abilities.name: Poison Swing
abilities.description: The xivilai winds up his weapon before swinging horizontally, indicated by a thin and long conical AoE, releasing a wave of poison wind dealing high poison damage, followed by poison damage over time.

mechanics.description: The xivilai winds up his weapon before swinging horizontally, indicated by a thin and long conical AoE, releasing a wave of poison wind dealing high poison damage, followed by poison damage over time.
mechanics.name: Poison Swing

dialogue.line: "Think you can take me? You're wrong!"

Unspecified.line: "Think you can take me? You're wrong!"

summary: The Xivilai Toxicoli is xivilai warrior who serves as the mini-boss of the fourth wave of enemies during Stage 6: Spiral Shadows in Maelstrom Arena.
